description: This file defines the SecurityPolicy class in the Twig sandbox component, implementing security checks for tags, filters, functions, methods, and properties to enforce sandbox restrictions.

classes.name: SecurityPolicy
classes.description: Implements security enforcement for Twig sandbox mode, managing allowed tags, filters, methods, properties, and functions, and performing security checks.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the security policy with allowed tags, filters, methods, properties, and functions.

methods.name: setAllowedTags
methods.description: Sets the list of allowed tags.

methods.name: setAllowedFilters
methods.description: Sets the list of allowed filters.

methods.name: setAllowedMethods
methods.description: Sets the allowed methods for classes.

methods.name: setAllowedProperties
methods.description: Sets the allowed properties for classes.

methods.name: checkSecurity
methods.description: Checks if the provided tags, filters, and functions are allowed, throwing errors or deprecation warnings as needed.

methods.name: checkMethodAllowed
methods.description: Verifies if a method call on an object is permitted.

methods.name: checkPropertyAllowed
methods.description: Verifies if a property access on an object is permitted.
